title: Vegetable Paella with Artichoke-Style Courgette and Peas
summary: A vibrant vegan paella with saffron-style golden rice, tender courgette prepared in an artichoke-style way, and sweet peas. It’s sunny, savoury, and ideal for a relaxed dinner.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a wide paella pan or large frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion and red pepper with a pinch of salt, and cook for 6–8 minutes until softened and lightly golden.
Stir in the garlic, paprika, turmeric, oregano, black pepper, and the courgette wedges. Cook for 3–4 minutes until the courgette starts to colour at the edges.
Add the rice and stir for 1 minute so the grains are well coated in the oil and spices.
Pour in the canned tomatoes and water, then season with the remaining salt. Bring to a steady simmer and spread the rice out evenly in the pan. Do not stir after this point.
Cook uncovered for about 18–20 minutes, adding the peas in the last 5 minutes. The rice should be tender, the liquid mostly absorbed, and the base just beginning to catch for a paella-style crust.
Mix the lemon juice with the courgette pieces if you want them sharper and more artichoke-like in flavour, then spoon them back over the top of the paella.
Scatter over the parsley and serve with lemon wedges on the side.
